title: Enterprise Connectivity: source exposure ceiling
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this source exposure ceiling rule to net transfer invoice.

## Basis: exposure bound
For net transfer invoice, the assisted posting ceiling is the undiscounted source subtotal multiplied by the Support fraction and then by the Network tier resource-count ceiling; this is a source exposure bound, not an extra charge.

## Basis Q&A
| Net transfer invoice basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Net transfer invoice: The assisted posting ceiling is the undiscounted source subtotal multiplied by the Support fraction and then by the Network tier resource-count ceiling | this is a source exposure bound, not an extra charge. |

## Hypothetical exposure bound
Assume a hypothetical undiscounted transfer subtotal of USD 90, support fraction of 0.06 and tier resource count of 10. Multiplication gives a source exposure bound of USD 54. The resource count scales the bound and does not create an additional service charge.
